{{Top}}
{{Quote|All wings report in.|Garven Dreis|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:OddBall.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Davijaan/Legends|Odd Ball]] in his starfighter]]
'''Callsigns''' (alternatively spelled '''call sign''') were frequency names or numbers assigned to each [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], used to save communication [[Time/Legends|time]] and confusion. It was also a name for a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] on a [[communications net]], as well as [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] squads.
